task_description: Three agents collaboratively plan and execute a project to build a simple automated greenhouse with distinct phases: design, procurement, and construction. Each phase requires coordination and resource allocation, with dependencies between tasks in each phase.
expected_outcome: The agents successfully break down the complex project into subtasks, allocate resources without conflicts, coordinate execution, and complete the greenhouse construction smoothly.

agents.description: Agent 1 is responsible for creating the overall project plan, breaking down the project into subtasks, and assigning initial resources.
Agent 2 handles the identification and procurement of necessary resources and materials as outlined in the project plan.
Agent 3 coordinates the actual construction work, ensuring tasks are completed on time and dependencies are properly managed.
